name: Cavalier Eagle Lord
body:
An eagle lord is a noble warrior that flies across the battlefield astride a giant eagle.

Alignment: An eagle lord must be good-aligned.

Giant Eagle Mount (Ex)

An eagle lord gains a giant eagle companion instead of a mount. This companion progresses as a druid animal companion except that the skills per HD are higher due to the creature’s higher Intelligence. You cannot gain any feat that replaces your mount and you must gain another giant eagle as a mount if your previous mount dies or is released from service.

This ability replaces mount, tactician, greater tactician, and master tactician.

Giant Eagle Companion Size Large; Speed 10 ft., fly 80 ft. (average); AC +1 natural armor; Attack bite 1d6, 2 claws (1d8); Ability Scores Str 14, Dex 17, Con 10, Int 10, Wis 15, Cha 11; Special Qualities low-light vision, understands Auran; Perception +4 7th-level advancement

AC +2 natural armor; Str +4, Con +2

Approved Order: An eagle lord can only join an order approved by their mount. These tend to be noble or goodly orders.

This ability modifies order.

Eagle Eyed (Ex)

At 4th level, an eagle lord gains a +4 bonus to sight-based Perception checks.

This ability replaces expert trainer.
